name: Breezy Hill Farm
tagline: BREEZY HILL FARM OF OHIO LLC
description: Breezy Hill Farm is an on-farm market in 23342 Bowman Rd., OH, selling produce straight from the field. Because everything is sold where it is grown, selection follows the local harvest calendar. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
